origin.title: Astrakhan → Moscow → everywhere
origin.body: 2009, Astrakhan: the debut album drops and the band hits the road for the first time, Moscow included. A year later they relocate to the capital for good. That's where a friendship with Noize MC begins — one that later turns into joint tracks and never really stops.

discography.title: Eight albums, one genre that never sounds the same twice
discography.sub: From the debut to the freshly released 'Night With an Astrakhan Native' — no gaps.

collabs.title: Company that raises the bar
collabs.body: A long-running friendship and joint tracks with Noize MC. Two hits with punk veterans Tarakany!, one of them holding the top spot on a major rock chart for twenty weeks straight.

booking.title: Booking the band for a show?
booking.body: International touring circuit, a tight production crew, gear partnerships with Sennheiser, Roland, Kiesel Guitars and Adidas. Rider and terms on request.

materials.title: Press kit & rider
materials.hint: Password-protected — access for promoters and partners only.

diy.title: Funded by the crowd
diy.body: Mastering for two albums was crowdfunded on Planeta.ru — both times the goal was hit ahead of schedule. Not a label's money. The audience paid upfront.
